title: Sliding number tiles merge puzzle
when: The user wants the 4x4 puzzle where all tiles slide in one direction and equal numbers merge into their double, with score and undo.
prompt:
Goal: Exact merge rules, responsive swipes and quick animations on a 4x4 board.
Steps:
1. logic.mjs slideRow(row): compact, merge equal neighbors once per move (2 2 2 2 gives 4 4), return { row, gained }; move(board, dir) by rotating and reusing slideRow; canMove(board).
2. Only after a move that changed the board, spawn a 2 (90 percent) or 4 in a random empty cell with injectable random.
3. Input: arrows and WASD, pointer swipes (30 px threshold, dominant axis), and on screen buttons.
4. Tiles as absolutely positioned elements moved with transform transitions of 120 ms; none under prefers-reduced-motion.
5. Score, best (localStorage guarded) and one step Undo; "Moved left, plus 16" and game over in aria-live.
6. Reaching the target tile (default 2048) shows a win message with Keep going.
7. test.mjs: merge rules, no spawn without change, canMove on a full board.
Quality bar:
- A tile merges once per move.
- Swipes do not scroll the page.
- Tile values readable with contrast at every color.
Pitfalls:
- Merging 4 4 8 into 16 in one move.
- Spawning after a move that changed nothing.
- Rendering by rebuilding innerHTML.
Verify:
- [ ] Merge cases tested.
- [ ] Status live.
- [ ] Reduced motion rule exists.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (board rules), test.mjs.

examples.input: a sliding number merge puzzle game
examples.output: 4x4 board, swipe and arrows, score and best, undo, win at the target tile
